name: Ōfunato (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ōfunato city emblem in white: two curved strokes with rounded ends above a stylised letter X.
history: Municipal flag of Ōfunato, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 December 1952.

features.role: Ōfunato city emblem — two curved strokes with rounded ends above a stylised letter X
